notes.title: Update notes Version 2.0 NEW GAME PLUS
notes.content:
Its finally here! NEW GAME PLUS is a new game mode which adds a challenging spin on Shotgun Knight. The birds seek vengeance. Will you make it to the top? 

Trailer:
[previewyoutube=0-BQ63rVYCo;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*] Added new game plus mode which can only be played after completing the main game
[*] New Collectable in New Game Plus
[*] Various Bug fixes
[/list]
